items.measurement_method: Count decision rows per run from the action ledger.

objectives.objective: every choice has a decision row

items.target: every choice has a decision row

items.baseline: not measured - no instrument exists (recorded as a kata on the kata project)
items.capabilities: Tool platform (version, probe, binding, effect ceiling, ledger)
items.cost: T13 plus the absorption of the remaining services
kpis: zero-use toolkits retired after a programme cycle (P10)
items.measurement_method: The tool_call ledger's per-toolkit counts, read at the tranche review; retirement is a decision.
items.observable_outcome: Every cluster service a job may call is a versioned, bound, audited toolkit with a ledger.
items.risks: the unowned fleet keeps growing while toolkits wait
items.target: every service a job uses is a toolkit; a toolkit with no calls in a cycle is retired or justified

items.baseline: not measured - no instrument exists (recorded as a kata on the kata project)
items.capabilities: Development project (T6) on the PM job (T3) and the plan spine (T1)
items.cost: T6's tranche-11 build plus the CI budget
kpis: a development run reaches live verification with a recorded rollback
items.measurement_method: The development project's run, CI and deploy records; the lane and PR are the evidence.
objectives: O5 The conveyor develops and operates itself under its own gates
items.observable_outcome: A development project runs lane -> PR -> CI -> merge -> deploy -> live verify, with rollback, through the conveyor.
preconditions: CI runners and the deploy path
items.risks: the CI queue or a flaky gate makes the loop unusable
items.target: one self-development run reaches live verification on evidence; a second is repeatable

items.baseline: not measured - no instrument exists (recorded as a kata on the kata project)
items.capabilities: The public design site and the contribution path (issue forms, DCO, CONTRIBUTING)
items.cost: the site's maintenance and review time
kpis: an outside issue or PR that changes a published output
items.measurement_method: The GitHub issue registry and merged PR authors; the publications are recorded on the programme issues.
objectives: O6 The public can see and challenge the design
items.observable_outcome: An outside reader can read every published output, and an outside issue or PR changes the design.
items.target: at least one outside contribution changes a published output; every output is reachable

items.baseline: not measured - no instrument exists (recorded as a kata on the kata project)
kpis: no concept with two stores (the T0 gate)
items.measurement_method: The T0 gate test and the absorption inventory; a second store is a defect.
items.observable_outcome: A concept has one table and one action registry; no concept has two stores.
items.risks: a parallel store appears as a convenience
items.target: the T0 gate exists and refuses a second store; the registry has one home

cost.realization: no new spend; the existing programme roles and records

items.body: The one-organisation-loop proof (issue #88, T12) has no test and T5/T6 are proposed. The programme's viability verdict must not claim V2 acceptance; tranche 12 cannot record a continue on unbuilt work.
items.title: V2 acceptance (#88/T12) remains open

items.body: All six benefit profiles are draft with placeholder baselines and no measurement instrument. U6 owns the instruments and the before/after transition; no benefit may be claimed realized before that measurement.
items.title: The six benefit baselines are placeholders

items.body: T5, T6, T12, T15 and T17 are proposed, not built. Their tranches must end in pause or stop rather than a fabricated continue, and no project is chartered or closed on unbuilt work.
items.title: Tranches 5 and 10-13 cannot deliver on proposed projects
Scope vs capacity: 538 packages + 480 artefacts + 13 tranches
Record theatre: sections resolve thinly, registers look operated but are not
Instrument self-deception: a check passes by construction
Live transport/pool: SSH forward, branch binary, one writer
Register staleness: allocation from an old snapshot
Standard completeness: a tailored profile omits a clause
Peers/shared main: overlapping files and pending SPEC edits
v1 quality unknown: the verdict may find real work
Nullable project_id: a consumer returns zero rows silently
Seed quality: wrong statuses or duplicate ADR ids
Evidence theatre: the plan claims progress it cannot read back
CI/agent budget: an agent burst or a probe run
